requirement: A place snapshot whose source is past 30 days but whose last retry just failed is no longer reported fresh; the retry cooldown still keeps it from being run again

oracle.ref: PR #1686 (fix); fix evidence: Before the fix snapshotFresh returned !sourceDue for every source, so a 35-day-old source in its retry cooldown read fresh
oracle.invariant: S1: snapshotFresh = false; snapshotDue = false now and true after SOURCE_RETRY_MS. S2: fresh only for the recent collection and the settled answer within 30 days. S3: the TripAdvisor freshness test passes.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: a source collected long ago whose retry just failed is stale data
a recent collection is fresh and not due
a settled "the place has nothing there" answer is fresh within the max age
a source that failed on our setup and never collected is not fresh
an unpublished or background-only snapshot is neither fresh nor spared a run
fresh snapshot is enriched for a newly enabled source
